---
title: "Sensitivity of sectoral stock returns to RBI monetary policy changes"
format: pdf
editor: visual
---

## Packages


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(plm)
library(lubridate)
```

## Creating a sector combined dataset 

```{r}
data$NIFTY_BANK$Sector <- "BANK"
data$NIFTY_IT$Sector <- "IT"
data$NIFTY_AUTO$Sector <- "AUTO"
data$NIFTY_FMCG$Sector <- "FMCG"
data$NIFTY_pharma$Sector <- "PHARMA"
data$NIFTY_REALTY$Sector <- "REALTY"

sector_names <- setdiff(names(data), c("NIFTY50", "CPI", "repo_clean"))

panel_list <- lapply(sector_names,function(name){
  df=data[[name]] %>% 
    select("Date","Return") %>% 
    mutate(Sector=name)
  return(df)
})

# Reload NIFTY_IT fresh
library(readxl)

# Replace with your actual file path
data$NIFTY_IT <- read_excel("E:/Project/NIFTY IT.xlsx")

# Fix date
data$NIFTY_IT$Date <- as.Date(data$NIFTY_IT$Date)

# Fix numeric columns
data$NIFTY_IT <- data$NIFTY_IT %>%
  mutate(across(c(Open, High, Low, Close), 
                ~as.numeric(as.character(.))))

# Calculate return cleanly
data$NIFTY_IT <- data$NIFTY_IT %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  mutate(Return = log(Close / lag(Close))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Return))

# Verify
class(data$NIFTY_IT)
range(data$NIFTY_IT$Return, na.rm = TRUE)
head(data$NIFTY_IT)

panel_data <- bind_rows(panel_list)
View(panel_data)

panel_data$Sector <- gsub("NIFTY_","",panel_data$Sector)

Market <- data$NIFTY50 %>% 
  select("Date",Market_Return="Return") 
  
head(panel_data)
unique(panel_data$Sector)

panel_data <- left_join(panel_data, market, by = "Date")

```

## Mergining Repo Change

```{r}
panel_data <- left_join(panel_data,repo_clean[,c("Date","Change")],by="Date")

panel_data <- panel_data$Change %>%
  replace(panel_data$Change,NA,0)
  
panel_data$Change[is.na(panel_data$Change)] <- 0

```

## Panel data and Regression

```{r}
pdata <- pdata.frame(panel_data,index=c("Sector","Date"))

model_fe <- plm(Return~Change,data = pdata,model = "within")
summary(model_fe)

model <- plm(Return~Change+Market_Return,data = pdata,model="within")
summary(model)

model1 <- plm(Return~Change*Sector+Market_Return,data = pdata,model="within")
summary(model1)
```

```{r}
# Calculate total sensitivity per sector
comparison_table <- data.frame(
  Sector = c("AUTO", "BANK", "FMCG", "IT", "PHARMA", "REALTY"),
  Beta_Repo = c(
    0.00032082,
    0.00032082 - 0.00155118,
    0.00032082 - 0.00030457,
    0.00032082 - 0.00054223,
    0.00032082 - 0.00149904,
    0.00032082 - 0.00772438
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Abs_Sensitivity = abs(Beta_Repo),
    Direction = ifelse(Beta_Repo > 0, "Positive", "Negative")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Abs_Sensitivity))

print(comparison_table)
```

## Plot

```{r}
comparison_table %>%
  mutate(Sector = reorder(Sector, Beta_Repo)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Sector, y = Beta_Repo, fill = Direction)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Positive" = "#2ecc71", 
                                "Negative" = "#e74c3c")) +
  labs(title = "Sectoral Sensitivity to RBI Repo Rate Changes",
       subtitle = "Based on Daily Panel Regression with Fixed Effects (2011-2026)",
       x = "Sector",
       y = "Repo Rate Sensitivity (Beta)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))


```
